content: Phawuloosa Zaaruwa
Agirphi Phawuloosako, “Neeni nebaa odanaw danda7aasa” yaagis. He wode Phawuloosi ba kushiya denthidi haysada yaagis:
“Kawaw, Agirpha, Ayhudeti tana mootidabaas zaaro immanaw hachi ne sinthan eqashe ta qaaday lo77o gada qopayis.
Neeni Ayhude woganne palama loythada eriya gisho tana saletonna si7ana mela nena woossayis.
“Taani na7atethafe doomada ta asaa giddoninne Yerusalaamen de7ida ta de7uwa Ayhude ubbay eroosona.
Taani koyrope doomada, nu haymaanote higgiya minthidi naagiya Farsaaweta yaraape gideysa enti markatanaw koyko eroosona.
Ha77ika taani Xoossay nu aawatas immana gida ufaysaa naagiya gisho mootetada haysan eqas.

Qassi tammanne nam7u nu aawata sheeshay Xoossaa qammanne gallas minthidi goyinnishe Xoossay immana gidaysa ekanaw ufaysan naagoosona. Kawaw Agirpha, Ayhudeti tana mootey taani ufaysan hessa naagiya gishosa.
Ayhudeto, Xoossay hayqidaysata dentheysa ayis ammaneketii?
“Kase taani ta huuphenka Naazirete Yesuusa sunthaa teqanaw danda7etidaba ubbaa oothanaw bessees gada qopas.
Taani Yerusalaamen oothiday haysa. Kahine halaqatape maata ekada Xoossaa asatape darota qashisas. Enta wodhiya wodeka enta hayquwa dosas.
Daro wode ayhude woosa keethaa ubban enti seeretana melanne Yesuusa cayidi kaddana mela un7ethas. Taani wogi bayna enta hanqetada hari attoshin, hara biitta katamata gakanaw enta gooddas.
“Taani ha odas kahine halaqatape maatanne kiitaa ekada Damasqo bayis.
Kawaw, taani seeta gallas ogen de7ishin awa poo7ope daro aadhiya poo7oy ta yuushuwaninne taara beyisata yuushuwan salope poo7is.
Nuuni ubbayka sa7an kundida wode Ibraawetho doonan, ‘Saa7ola, Saa7ola, tana ayis goodday? Neeni, nena caddiya birata xam7a qakiko nena qohaasa’ yaagidi taw odishin si7as.
“Taani, ‘Godaw, neeni oonee?’ yaagas. “Goday, ‘Taani, neeni gooddiya Yesuusa;
shin denda eqa. Hachi neeni tana be7idaysaninne sinthafe ta new bessanaysa haratas markatana mela ta oosancho oothada nena shuumanaw new bentas.
Isra7eele asatapenne taani nena entako kiittiya Ayhude gidonaysatape nena ashshana.
Neeni enta ayfiya dooyana, dhumape poo7oko, Xalahe kushepe Xoossako enta zaarana. Enti tanan ammanidi nagara atotetha ekana. Xoossay doorida asaa giddon banta laata demmana’ yaagis.
“Kawaw Agirpha, hessa gisho, taw salope bentida qoncethas kiitetanaysa ixabike.

Shin taani koyrottada Damasqon hessafe guye Yerusalaameninne Yihuda biitta ubban de7eysatinne Ayhude gidonnaysati banta nagaraape Xoossaako simmana melanne nagaraape simuwa bessiya ooso oothana mela qaala odas.
Hessa gisho, Ayhudeti tana xoossa keethan oykidi wodhanaw koydosona.
Hachi gakanaw Xoossaa maadey taape shaaketibeenna; yaaniya gisho, guuthaasinne gitaas markatashe haysan eqas. Nabetinne Musey hanana gidi odidaysafe haraa issibaaka taani odidabay baawa.
Hessika, ‘Kiristoosi waaye ekanaw bessees; qassi hayqope koyro dendidi Ayhudetasinne Ayhude gidonaysatas atotetha poo7o odanaw bessees’ gidaysa” yaagis.
Phawuloosi hessa yaagidi zaarishin, Fisxoosi ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Phawuloosa, ne gooyadasa; ne daro timirtey nena gooshshatethas gathis” yaagis.
Shin Phawuloosi, “Boncho Fisxoosa, taani tumabaanne bessiyaba odaysipe attishin, gooyabike.
Taani qoncen odiya odaa Kawoy erees. Ha oday geeman oosetiboonna gisho issoyka iyape geemmonaysa taani geeshshada erayis.
“Kawaw Agirpha, neeni nabeta ammanaasa gidikii? Neeni ammaneysa taani erayis” yaagis.
Kawoy Agirphi, Phawuloosako, “Ha guutha saaten tana kiristaane oothanaw koyay?” yaagis.
Phawuloosi, “Daro wode gidin guutha wode ne xalaala gidonashin hachi tana si7iya ubbay ha qashuwape attishin, ta mela gidana mela Xoossaa woossayis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Kawoy Fisxoosi, Barniqeynne entara uttida ubbayka dendidosona.
Yaape keyidi bishe issoy issuwara, “Ha uray hayqos woyko qashos gathiyaba aykoka oothibeenna” yaagidi odetidosona.
Agirphi Fisxoosako, “Ha uray ‘Qeesarey tabaa pirdo’ goonnako biletanaw danda7ees shin” yaagis.
